create_recat_file <- function(data, var, directory = "recategorize") {

  out <- data %>%
    dplyr::count(.data[[var]], name = "n") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      !!paste0(var, "_recat") := NA_character_
    )

  writexl::write_xlsx(
    out,
    file.path(directory, paste0(var, ".xlsx"))
  )

  invisible(out)
}

recat_summary <- function(directory) {

  files <- list.files(
    directory,
    pattern = "\\.(csv|xlsx)$",
    full.names = TRUE
  )

  if (length(files) == 0) {
    return(tibble::tibble())
  }

  purrr::map_dfr(files, function(file) {

    recat_file <-
      if (grepl("\\.csv$", file, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
        readr::read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE)
      } else {
        readxl::read_excel(file)
      }

    original_var <- names(recat_file)[1]

    recat_file %>%
      dplyr::mutate(variable = original_var) %>%
      dplyr::rename(original_value = !!rlang::sym(original_var)) %>%
      tidyr::pivot_longer(
        -c(variable, original_value, n),
        names_to = "new_variable",
        values_to = "recategorized"
      ) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(
        new_variable,
        recategorized
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        recat_n = sum(n, na.rm = TRUE)
      ) %>%
      dplyr::ungroup() %>%
      dplyr::select(
        variable,
        original_value,
        original_n = n,
        new_variable,
        recategorized,
        recat_n
      ) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(
        variable,
        new_variable
      )

  })

}
